title: Restrain a spring-loaded tote lid with a loose elastic strap
instruction: Secure the tall tote's lid using exactly one of the four straps. Seat its two hooks on the two different bars, with the cord over the lid. Release every hook and the lid, and finish with the lid gap below 3 mm continuously for 20 seconds. Do not overload a hook or let a taut loose hook snap back.
context: Packing an overfilled tote requires choosing a strap that can reach both anchors and retain enough tension to hold the lid shut after release.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers stand on 16 x 16 x 20 cm rigid risers, bases at (0, +/-0.305, 0.95) m in the station frame. Table top z=0.7475 m. A fixed tray between the arms holds four initially loose straps: red 36 cm, blue 52 cm, yellow 58 cm, green 46 cm relaxed cord length. Each has two 50 g rigid hooks; white length cards are quarter-scale. The tall plastic tote at (0.50, 0) m has a 30 x 14 cm footprint, a blue 12 mm thick lid about 28 cm above the table when shut, 20 mm vertical lid travel, and two 6 mm diameter finite steel anchor bars on 8 cm brackets. The contents push upward by 30 N when shut and 15 N at full opening, excluding lid weight. A 26 x 14 cm low tote at (0.66, -0.42) m is a distractor. Initial hook poses, tray dimensions, tote solids and camera/mount geometry are specified by the packaged source; the fixed seed-42 layout must match the setup image.
scoring: Permanent guard failure gives 0. Otherwise the final uninterrupted state determines score: 1.0 for exactly one strap with hooks seated on different tall-tote bars, cord over lid and gap <3 mm for 20 s; 0.5 for that state with gap <=10 mm for 5 s; 0.25 for exactly one strap with at least one tall-bar hook seated for 5 s. All bands require no robot contact with any of the eight hooks or the tall lid. Other outcomes score 0. Hook load >28 N, taut unheld hook speed >0.5 m/s, wrist force >80 N for 0.1 s, invalid/missing measurements, or swept cord/solid penetration permanently veto score.
run_limit: 4,000 control steps at 20 Hz (200 seconds of simulated control time).
reset_notes: Restore all eight hooks to their fixed tray slots, release both tote lids to their upper stops and reset all permanent-failure and hold counters; use the supplied reset at seed 42.
fidelity: Rigid hooks, totes and lids use PhysX. A massless 8 mm analytic elastic cord follows the shortest route over lid edges; swept guards reject cord/solid penetration. Robot-cord collision and slack-shape dynamics are omitted; temporary cord/gripper contact can occur. Finite capsule anchor bars omit support hardware for axial entry. Contents are a spring-loaded sliding lid. Motor effort includes gravity within 27/7 Nm caps; fingers are limited to 22 N each. Hook overload is a 28 N failure proxy.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 4,000 controls. Scripted demo: 1.0 after 2,291 controls (114.55 simulated seconds), including a final 20-second hands-free hold.
